s.d: χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ (χείρ, τείνω) 1. to vote by stretching out the hand in the Athenian ἐκκλησία (Luc., Plut.). 2. to appoint: (a) by vote, [[2-corinthians 8 19|2Co.8:19]] (b) without vote, [[acts 14 23|Act.14:23]] (see Rackham, in l) (cf. προχειροτονέω).† (AS)
Χερουβείν (Rec. -βίμ), τά (Heb. כְּרוּב), Cherubim: [[hebrews 9 6|Heb.9:6]] (cf. [[exodus 25 17|Exo.25:17]] (18), al.; see DB, i, 377 ff.).† (AS)

χήρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אַלְמָנָה ;] a widow: [[matthew 23 13|Mat.23:13]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[mark 12 40|Mrk.12:40-43]], [[luke 2 37|Luk.2:37 4:25 7:12 18:3, 5 20:47 21:2-3]], [[acts 6 1|Act.6:1 9:39, 41]], [[1-corinthians 7 8|1Co.7:8]], [[1-timothy 5 3|1Ti.5:3-5 5:11 5:16]], [[james 1 27|Jas.1:27]]; γυνὴ χ., [[luke 4 26|Luk.4:26;]] of one of an ordo viduarum (see CGT, in l), [[1-timothy 5 9|1Ti.5:9;]] metaphorically, of a city forsaken, [[revelation 18 7|Rev.18:7.]]† (AS)

ἐχθές (Rec. χθές), adv., [in LXX for תְּמוֹל, etc. ;] yesterday: [[john 4 52|Jhn.4:52]], [[acts 7 28|Act.7:28]], [[hebrews 13 8|Heb.13:8]] (on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 370 f.).† ἐχθές, adverb ={χθές}, yesterday, ( 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Nubes” 175, “Th.” 616, etc.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ. “Anthologia Graeca” 11.35 (1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus); μέσφα τό γ᾽ ἐ. 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 2.144 ); οὐ γάρ τι νῦν γε κἀ. today or yesterday, ( 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Antigone” 456; οὐκ ἐ. οὐδὲ πρῴην 5th c.BC: Antipho Orator “fragment” 58 ); ἐ. καὶ τρίτης [ἡμέρας] ( LXX.Ruth.2.11, compare 2nd c.AD: Marcus Antoninus Imperator 10.7. (ἐχθές is commoner than χθές) in Comedy texts and LXX, is the only form used in “NT”, and frequently in papyri of all periods, ( “PSI” 4.442.21 (3rd c.BC), etc.)) (AS)

χιλιάς, -άδος, ἡ (χίλιοι), [in LXX for אֶלֶף ;] the number one thousand, a thousand: [[luke 14 31|Luk.14:31]], [[acts 4 4|Act.4:4]], [[1-corinthians 10 8|1Co.10:8]], [[revelation 5 11|Rev.5:11 7:4-8 11:13 14:1, 3 21:16]].† (AS)

χιλίαρχος (in Hdt., al., -ης), -ου, ὁ (χίλιοι, ἄρχω) [in LXX chiefly for אַלּוּף שַׂר ;] a chiliarch, the commander of a thousand, esp. a Roman military tribune, the commander of a cohort: [[john 18 12|Jhn.18:12]], [[acts 21 31|Act.21:31-33, 37 22:24-29 23:10, 15 23:17-19, 22 24:7, 22 25:23]]; more generally, of officers of similar rank, [[mark 6 21|Mrk.6:21]], [[revelation 6 15|Rev.6:15 19:18]] (see, DB, i, 352b; DCG, i, 271a, 307a).† (AS)
χίλιοι, -αι, -α a thousand: [[2-peter 3 8|2Pe.3:8]] (LXX), [[revelation 11 3|Rev.11:3 12:6 14:20 20:2-7]].† (AS)
χίος, -ου, ἡ Chios, an island in Ægean Sea: [[acts 20 15|Act.20:15.]]† (AS)

χιτών, ῶνος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for כְּתֹנֶת:] the garment worn next the skin (though two tunics were sometimes worn, see Swete, Mk., 117), a tunic: [[matthew 10 10|Mat.10:10]], [[mark 6 9|Mrk.6:9 14:63]], [[luke 3 11|Luk.3:11 9:3]], Ju 23; dieting. from ἱμάτιον (which see), [[matthew 5 40|Mat.5:40]], [[luke 6 29|Luk.6:29]], [[john 19 23|Jhn.19:23]], [[acts 9 39|Act.9:39]] (see DCG, i, 338, 340, 499) (AS)
χιών, -όνος, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁלֶג also (in Da) for תְּלַג ;] snow: [[matthew 28 3|Mat.28:3]], [[revelation 1 14|Rev.1:14]].† (AS)
χλαμύς, -ύδος, ἡ [in LXX: 2Ma.12:35 * ;] a chlamys, or short cloak worn over the χιτών (which see): [[matthew 27 28|Mat.27:28, 31]] (see Tr., Syn., § 1).† (AS)
χλευάζω (χλεύη, a jest), [in LXX: Wis.11:14, 2Ma.7:7, 4Ma.5:22 * ;] to jest, mock, jeer: [[acts 17 32|Act.17:32.]]† (AS)
χλιαρός, -ά, -όν (χλίω, to become warm), warm, tepid; metaphorically, of persons, luke-warm: [[revelation 3 16|Rev.3:16.]]† (AS)
Χλόη, -ης, ἡ (i.e. tender foliage), Chloe: [[1-corinthians 1 11|1Co.1:11.]]† (AS)
Χλόη, -ης, ἡ (i.e. tender foliage), Chloe: [[1-corinthians 1 11|1Co.1:11.]]† (AS)
Χλόη, -ης, ἡ (i.e. tender foliage), Chloe: [[1-corinthians 1 11|1Co.1:11.]]† (AS)

χλωρός, -ά, -όν (χλόη), [in LXX for יֶרֶק, etc. ;] (a) pale green: χόρτος, [[mark 6 39|Mrk.6:39]], [[revelation 8 7|Rev.8:7]]; πᾶν χ., [[revelation 9 4|Rev.9:4;]] (b) pale: ἵππος, [[revelation 6 8|Rev.6:8.]]† (AS)

χξς ́ (on ς, see: Z), in T, Tr., Rec. for ἑξακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα ἕξ, six hundred and sixty-six (L, mg., R, mg., six hundred and sixteen), the mystical number of the Beast: [[revelation 13 18|Rev.13:18]] (on the interpretation, see Swete, Ap., 172 f.).† (AS)
χοϊκός, -ή, -όν, (χοῦς) earthy, made of dust: [[1-corinthians 15 47|1Co.15:47-49]] (see Field, Notes, 179 f.).† (AS)
χοῖνιξ, -ικος, ἡ [in LXX: [[ezekiel 45 10|Eze.45:10-11]] (בַּת) * ;] a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart: [[revelation 6 6|Rev.6:6]] (EV, measure).† (AS)
χολάω, -ῶ (χολή), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:1 R * ;] 1. to be melancholy mad (Aristoph.). 2. = χολοῦμαι, to be angry: with dative of person(s), [[john 7 23|Jhn.7:23.]]† (AS)

χολή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX for רֹאשׁ, לַעֲנָה, מְרֵרָה ;] gall: [[matthew 27 34|Mat.27:34]] (here prob. = myrrh, cf. [[mark 15 23|Mrk.15:23]], see Swete, in l; DCG, i, 634); metaphorically, [[acts 8 23|Act.8:23.]]† (AS)

χοῦς, -οός accusative, οῦν, ὁ, (contr. from χόος), [in LXX chiefly for עָפָר ;] 1. earth, soil. 2. In later writers (Pint., LXX), = κονιορτός, dust: [[mark 6 11|Mrk.6:11]], [[revelation 18 19|Rev.18:19]].† (AS)
Χοραζείν (Rec. -ζίν), ἡ, Chorazin, a town of Galilee: [[matthew 11 21|Mat.11:21]], [[luke 10 13|Luk.10:13]].† (AS)

χορηγέω, -ῶ (χορός, ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for כּוּל pilp. ;] 1. to lead a χορός (see LS, see word). 2. to defray the cost of a χορός. 3. In late writers, metaphorically, with accusative (see M, Pr., 65), to supply, furnish abundantly: [[2-corinthians 9 10|2Co.9:10]], [[1-peter 4 11|1Pe.4:11]] (Polyb., al.).† (AS)
χορός, -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for מָחוֹל, מְחֹלָה ;] a dance: pl., [[luke 15 26|Luk.15:25.]]† (AS)

χορτάζω (χόρτος), [in LXX for שָׂבַע, [[psalms 17 14|Psa.17:14]] al. ;] (a) prop., of animals (see Lft. on [[philippians 4 12|Php.4:12]]), to feed, fatten: [[revelation 19 21|Rev.19:21;]] (b) in late Gk. (Kennedy, Sources, 82, 156), of persons, to fill or satisfy with food: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 15 33|Mat.15:33;]] pass., [[matthew 14 20|Mat.14:20 15:37]], [[mark 6 42|Mrk.6:42 7:27 8:8]], [[luke 9 17|Luk.9:17]], [[john 6 26|Jhn.6:26]], [[james 2 16|Jas.2:16]]; opposite to πεινᾶν, [[philippians 4 12|Php.4:12;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[mark 8 4|Mrk.8:4;]] ἀπό, [[luke 16 21|Luk.16:21;]] ἐκ, [[luke 15 16|Luk.15:16]], WH, txt.; metaphorically, [[matthew 5 6|Mat.5:6]], [[luke 6 21|Luk.6:21]].† (AS)

χόρτασμα, -τος, τό (χορτάζω), [in LXX: [[genesis 24 25|Gen.24:25, 32 42:27 43:24]], [[judges 19 19|Jdg.19:19]] (מִסְפּוֹא), [[deuteronomy 11 16|Deu.11:16]] (עֶשֶׂב), (Sir.33:24) Sir.38:26 * ;] fodder (Polyb., Plut., al.): pl., [[acts 7 11|Act.7:11]] (RV, sustenance).† (AS)

χόρτος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for עֶשֶׂב, also for חָצִיר, etc. ;] 1. an enclosure, a feeding place (Hom.). 2. food, esp. for cattle, grass: [[matthew 13 26|Mat.13:26 14:19]], [[mark 4 28|Mrk.4:28 6:39]], [[luke 12 28|Luk.12:28]], [[john 6 10|Jhn.6:10]], [[1-corinthians 3 12|1Co.3:12]], [[james 1 10|Jas.1:10-11]], [[1-peter 1 24|1Pe.1:24]]" (LXX), [[revelation 9 4|Rev.9:4;]] χ. χλωρός, [[mark 6 39|Mrk.6:39]], [[revelation 8 7|Rev.8:7]].† (AS)
Χουζᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ Chuzas (EV, Chuza): [[luke 8 3|Luk.8:3.]]† (AS)

χράομαι, χρῶμαι (χρή), [in LXX for עָשָׂה, etc. ;] to use, make use of: with dative (cf. M, Pr., 64, 158), [[acts 27 17|Act.27:17]], [[1-corinthians 9 12|1Co.9:12 9:15]], [[1-timothy 1 8|1Ti.1:8 5:23]]; μᾶλλον χρῆσαι (i.e. the opportunity; see M, Pr., 247), [[1-corinthians 7 21|1Co.7:21;]] as some­times in late writers (cf. M, Pr., 64; Lft., Notes, 233), with accusative, [[1-corinthians 7 31|1Co.7:31;]] of feelings, etc., to exercise, shew: [[2-corinthians 1 17|2Co.1:17 3:12]]; with adv., ἀποτόμως, to deal sharply, [[2-corinthians 13 10|2Co.13:10;]] with dative of person(s) (cl.), to treat, deal with, [[acts 27 3|Act.27:3.]]† (AS)
χράω, κίχρημι [in LXX for לָוָה, etc. ;] to lend: [[luke 11 5|Luk.11:5.]]† (AS)

χρεία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 2 16|2Ch.2:16]] (15) (צֹרֶךְ), [[esther 7 20|Est.7:20]] (חַשְׁחוּת) frequently in Sir.1:1-30 -2 Mac ;] 1. need, necessity: [[acts 28 10|Act.28:10]], [[titus 3 14|Tit.3:14]]; πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χ. (RV, txt., for edifying as the need may be; but see Field, Notes, 192), [[ephesians 4 29|Eph.4:29;]] ἕστι χ., [[luke 10 42|Luk.10:42]], [[hebrews 7 11|Heb.7:11]]; χ. ἔχειν, with genitive, [[matthew 6 8|Mat.6:8 21:3]], [[mark 11 3|Mrk.11:3]], [[luke 9 11|Luk.9:11 15:7 19:31, 34 22:71]], [[john 13 29|Jhn.13:29]], [[1-corinthians 12 21|1Co.12:21 12:24]], [[1-thessalonians 4 12|1Th.4:12]], [[hebrews 10 36|Heb.10:36]], [[revelation 21 23|Rev.21:23 22:5]]; before τοῦ, with inf. (Bl., § 71, 3), [[hebrews 5 12|Heb.5:12;]] absol. (sc. genitive), [[acts 2 45|Act.2:45 4:35]]; with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 9 12|Mat.9:12 26:65]], [[mark 2 17|Mrk.2:17 14:63]], [[luke 5 31|Luk.5:31]]; with inf. (Bl., § 69, 5), [[matthew 3 14|Mat.3:14 14:16]], [[john 13 10|Jhn.13:10]], [[1-thessalonians 1 8|1Th.1:8 4:9]]; before ἵνα, [[john 16 30|Jhn.16:30]], [[1-john 2 27|1Jn.2:27]]; absol., [[mark 2 25|Mrk.2:25]], [[ephesians 4 28|Eph.4:28]], [[1-john 3 17|1Jn.3:17]]; οὐδὲν χ. ἔχειν, [[revelation 3 17|Rev.3:17;]] ἡ χ., with genitive subjc., [[philippians 2 25|Php.2:25 4:16, 19]]; pl., [[acts 20 34|Act.20:34]], [[romans 12 13|Rom.12:13]]. 2. matter, business (so esp. in late writers, Polyb., al.; 1Ma.12:45, al.): [[acts 6 3|Act.6:3]].† (AS)

χρεοφειλέτης (Rec. χρεω-, WH, χρεοφιλ-; see WH, App., 152, 154), -ου, ὁ, (χρέος, a debt, + ὀφειλέτης) [in LXX: [[job 31 37|Job.31:37]], [[proverbs 29 13|Pro.29:13]] * ;] a debtor: [[luke 7 41|Luk.7:41 16:5]].† (AS)
χρή impers. (χράω, see LS, see word), it is necessary: [[james 3 10|Jas.3:10]] (cf. δεῖ.).† (AS)

χρῄζω (χρή) [in LXX [[judges 11 7|Jdg.11:7]], [[1-samuel 17 18|1Ki.17:18]] A * ;] to need, have need of: with genitive of thing(s), [[matthew 6 32|Mat.6:32]], [[luke 11 8|Luk.11:8 12:30]], [[2-corinthians 3 1|2Co.3:1]]; with genitive of person(s) before ἐν, [[romans 16 2|Rom.16:2.]]† (AS)

χρῆμα, -τος, τό (χράομαι) [in LXX: [[joshua 22 8|Jos.22:8]], [[2-chronicles 1 11|2Ch.1:11-12]] (נֶכֶס), [[job 27 17|Job.27:17]] (כֶּסֶף), etc.; frequently in Sir (5:1, 8, al.), 2 and 4 Mac ;] a thing that one uses or needs (and generally, a matter, event, business); hence in pl., (a) wealth, riches: οἱ τά χ. ἔχοντες, [[mark 10 23|Mrk.10:23-24]], [[luke 18 24|Luk.18:24]]; (b) money: [[acts 8 18|Act.8:18, 20 24:26]]; sing. (rare in cl.) of a special sum of money, [[acts 4 37|Act.4:37.]]† (AS)

χρηματίζω (χρῆμα), [in LXX: [[jeremiah 26 2|Jer.26:2 29:23 30:2 36:2, 4]] A (דָבַר pi.), [[jeremiah 25 30|Jer.25:30]]) (שָׁאַג), 3Ki.18:27, [[job 40 8|Job.40:8]] * ;] 1. to transact business, hence, to consult, deliberate (Thuc., Dem., al.); hence in later writers, 2. to make answer (esp. of offcial pronounce­ments by magistrates, etc.; in π. of the royal reply to an ἔντευξις, which see; cf. Deiss., BS, 122); of an answer by an oracle (Died., Plut., al.); in FlJ, LXX and NT, of divine communications, to instruct, admonish, warn: pass. (Bl., § 54, 3), [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22]], [[hebrews 8 5|Heb.8:5 11:7 12:25]]; with inf. (Bl., § 69,4; 70, 3; 72, 5), [[matthew 2 12|Mat.2:12]], [[luke 2 26|Luk.2:26]], [[acts 10 22|Act.10:22]] 3. to assume a name (as in business), be called (Polyb., al.): [[acts 11 26|Act.11:26]], [[romans 7 3|Rom.7:3]] (gnomic fut.; cf. Burton, § 69).† (AS)
χρηματισμός, -οῦ), ὁ (χρηματίζω, which see), [in LXX: [[proverbs 31 1|Pro.31:1]] (מַשָּׂא), 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 11:17 * ;] a divine response, an oracle: [[romans 11 4|Rom.11:4]] (Xen., Plat., al.).† (AS)
χρήσιμος, -η, -ον (χράομαι), [in LXX: [[genesis 37 26|Gen.37:26]] בֶּצַע etc. ;] useful: [[2-timothy 2 14|2Ti.2:14.]]† (AS)

χρῆσις, -εως, ἡ (χράομαι), [in LXX: [[1-samuel 1 28|1Ki.1:28]] (שָׁאַל), Sir.18:8, al. ;] use: in a sexual sense, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26;]] with genitive obj., θηλείας, [[romans 1 27|Rom.1:27]] (for exx., see Thayer, see word).† (AS)
χρηστεύομαι (χρηστός), to be kind: [[1-corinthians 13 4|1Co.13:4]] (eccl.).† (AS)
χρηστολογία, -ας, ἡ (χρηστός, λέγω), fair speaking: in bad sense, [[romans 16 18|Rom.16:18]] (in good sense also, eccl.).† (AS)

χρηστός, -ή, -όν (χράομαι), [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב (frequently of God: [[psalms 25 8|Psa.25:8]], al.), also for יָקָר ([[ezekiel 27 22|Eze.27:22 28:13]]), יָשָׁר ([[proverbs 2 21|Pro.2:21]] א A) ;] serviceable, good; (a) of things, good, pleasant: of food (as often in cl.), οἶνος, [[luke 5 39|Luk.5:39;]] ζυγός, [[matthew 11 30|Mat.11:30]] (EV, easy); in ethical sense, ἤθη, [[1-corinthians 15 33|1Co.15:33;]] (b) of persons, good, kind, gracious: [[ephesians 4 32|Eph.4:32;]] of God, [[luke 6 35|Luk.6:35]], [[1-peter 2 3|1Pe.2:3]]; τ. χρηστὸν (= ἡ χρηστότης) τοῦ θεοῦ, [[romans 2 4|Rom.2:4.]] † (AS)

χρηστότης, -ητος, ἡ (χρηστός), [in LXX for טוּב and cogn. forms ;] 1. goodness, excellence, uprightness: [[romans 3 12|Rom.3:12]] (LXX). 2. goodness of heart, kindness: [[romans 2 4|Rom.2:4]], [[2-corinthians 6 6|2Co.6:6]], [[galatians 5 22|Gal.5:22]], [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12]], [[titus 3 4|Tit.3:4]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[ephesians 2 7|Eph.2:7;]] id., opposite to ἀποτομία, [[romans 11 22|Rom.11:22.]] SYN.: see: ἀγαθωσύνη. (AS)

χρίσμα (T, χρῖσμα, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 102; Bl., § 4, 2), -τος, το (χρίω), later form of χρῖμα (Æsch., al.), [in LXX for מִשְׁחָה and cogn. forms ([[exodus 29 7|Exo.29:7]], al.) ;] an anointing, unction (the result of the action χρίειν; ICC, in l; but cf. Westc., in l, for the view that the oil, not the act, is meant): [[1-john 2 20|1Jn.2:20]] [[john 2 27|Jn 2:27]].† (AS)

Χριστιανός (D, Χρεισ-; on the form Χρησ-, see Bl., § 3, 6; 27, 4 on the ending, -ανος, see Bl., ll. with; Deiss., LAE, 382), -οῦ ὁ, a Christian, the name first given to the disciples by pagan gentiles at Antioch: [[acts 11 26|Act.11:26 26:28]], [[1-peter 4 16|1Pe.4:16]] (see reff. in Thayer, see word; also DB, i, 384).† (AS)

χριστός (Χρ-), -ή, -όν (χρίω), [in LXX for מָשִׁיחַ and cogn. forms ;] 1. 1. as adj., (a) of things, anointing, to be used as ointment (Æsch., Eur., al.; τ. ἔλαιον τὸ χ., [[leviticus 21 10|Lev.21:10]]); (b) of persons, anointed (ὁ ἰερεὺς ὁ χ., [[leviticus 4 5|Lev.4:5;]] οἱ χ. ἰευρεῖς, 2Ma.1:10): ὁ χ. τοῦ κυρίου or Θεοῦ ([[1-samuel 2 10|1Ki.2:10]], [[psalms 2 2|Psa.2:2]], al.), of the Messiah (Aram., מְשִׁיחָא; cf. Dalman, Words, 289 ff.), [[luke 2 11|Luk.2:11, 26]] [[john 1 41|Jhn.1:41]], [[acts 2 36|Act.2:36 4:26]], al. 2. As subst., ὁ Χριστός, the Messiah, the Christ: [[matthew 2 4|Mat.2:4]], [[mark 8 29|Mrk.8:29]], [[luke 2 11|Luk.2:11]], [[john 1 20|Jhn.1:20]], [[acts 2 31|Act.2:31]], [[romans 7 4|Rom.7:4]], al.; Ἰησοῦς, [[mark 1 1|Mrk.1:1]], [[john 1 17|Jhn.1:17]], [[acts 2 38|Act.2:38]], al.; Χ. Ἰησοῦς, [[matthew 1 18|Mat.1:18]], WH, mg. [[acts 5 42|Act.5:42]], [[romans 6 3|Rom.6:3]], al.; Χ. κύριος, [[luke 2 11|Luk.2:11;]] Ἰησοῦς Χ. ὁ κύριος, [[acts 15 26|Act.15:26]], [[romans 1 7|Rom.1:7]], al. (AS)

χρίω to anoint (Hom., al.); [in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁח of consecration to a sacred office: priest, [[exodus 28 41|Exo.28:41;]] prophet, [[1-kings 19 16|3Ki.19:16;]] king, [[1-samuel 10 1|1Ki.10:1;]] of things, [[exodus 40 9|Exo.40:9]], [[leviticus 8 10|Lev.8:10]], al.]. In NT, metaphorically, of God's anointing, (a) Christ: [[acts 4 27|Act.4:27;]] with inf., [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18]] (LXX); with dupl. accusative (see B1., § 34, 4), [[hebrews 1 9|Heb.1:9]] (LXX); πνεύματι ἁγίῳ, [[acts 10 38|Act.10:38;]] (b) Christians: [[2-corinthians 1 21|2Co.1:21]] (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 73) (cf. ἐν-, ἐπι-Χριω).† SYN: see: ἀλείφω (AS)

χρονίζω (χρόνος), [in LXX chiefly for אָחַר pi. ;] to spend or take time, to tarry, linger, delay: [[matthew 24 48|Mat.24:48 25:5]], [[hebrews 10 37|Heb.10:37]]; before ἐν, with dative loc., [[luke 1 21|Luk.1:21;]] with inf., [[luke 12 45|Luk.12:45.]]† (AS)

χρόνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for יוֹם, also for עֵת, etc. ;] time (a space of time, whether long or short; cf. Lft., Notes, 70): [[matthew 2 7|Mat.2:7]], [[mark 9 21|Mrk.9:21]], [[luke 1 57|Luk.1:57]], [[acts 3 21|Act.3:21 7:17, 23 13:18 17:30 27:9]], [[hebrews 11 32|Heb.11:32]], [[1-peter 1 17|1Pe.1:17 4:3]], [[revelation 10 6|Rev.10:6]]; στιγμὴ χρόνου, [[luke 4 5|Luk.4:5;]] πλήρωμα τοῦ χ., [[galatians 4 4|Gal.4:4;]] ποιεῖν χ., [[acts 15 33|Act.15:33 18:23]]; βιῶσαι, [[1-peter 4 2|1Pe.4:2;]] διδόναι, [[revelation 2 21|Rev.2:21;]] pl., χ. καὶ (ἢ) καιροί (Lft., l.with), [[acts 1 7|Act.1:7]], [[1-thessalonians 5 1|1Th.5:1]]; ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῶν χ. (χρυσός), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;] golden, i.e. made or overlaid with gold: [[2-timothy 2 20|2Ti.2:20]], [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]], [[revelation 1 12|Rev.1:12-13, 20 2:1 4:4 5:8 8:3 9:13, 20 14:14 15:6-7 17:4 21:15]].† (AS)

χρυσίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of χρυσός, which see), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;] a piece of gold, gold: [[1-corinthians 3 12|1Co.3:12]], [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]], [[1-peter 1 7|1Pe.1:7]], [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18 21:18, 21]]; of golden ornaments, [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9]] (WH, txt., RV), [[1-peter 3 3|1Pe.3:3]], [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4 18:16]] (WH, txt., R); of gold coin, money, [[acts 3 6|Act.3:6 20:33]], [[1-peter 1 18|1Pe.1:18]].† (AS)
χρυσο-δακτύλιος, -ον with a gold ring: [[james 2 2|Jas.2:2.]]† (AS)

χρυσό-λιθος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[exodus 28 20|Exo.28:20 36:20]] ([[exodus 39 13|Exo.39:13]]), [[ezekiel 28 13|Eze.28:13]] (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) * ;] a chrysolite (on its identification, see Swete, Ap., 288 f.; DB, iv, 620): [[revelation 21 20|Rev.21:20.]]† (AS)
χρυσό-πρασος, -ου, ὁ a chrysoprase (see Swete, Ap., 289): [[revelation 21 20|Rev.21:20.]]† (AS)

[[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12, 16]] (Rec., WH, mg.); of images, [[acts 17 29|Act.17:29;]] of gold coin, [[matthew 10 9|Mat.10:9.]]† (AS)

χρώς, genitive, χρωτός, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for בָּשָׂר ;] in cl. rare in prose, the surface of the body, skin: [[acts 19 12|Act.19:12.]]† (AS)

χώρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX for אֶרֶץ, מְדִינָה, etc. ;] 1. most frequently in cl., a space, place. 2. land, i.e. (a) a land, country, region: [[matthew 12 2|Mat.12:2]], [[mark 5 10|Mrk.5:10 6:55]], [[luke 2 8|Luk.2:8 15:13-15 19:12]], [[john 11 54|Jhn.11:54]], [[acts 13 49|Act.13:49 27:27]]; χ. Γαλατική, [[acts 16 6|Act.16:6 18:23]]; Τραχωνίτιδος, [[luke 3 1|Luk.3:1;]] τ. Ἰουδαίας, [[acts 26 20|Act.26:20;]] τ. Ἰουδαίων, [[acts 10 39|Act.10:39;]] pl., τῆς Ἰουδαίας κ. Σαμαρείας, [[acts 8 1|Act.8:1;]] Γεργεσηνῶν (Γερασηνῶν, Γαδαρηνῶν) [[matthew 8 28|Mat.8:28]], [[mark 5 1|Mrk.5:1]], [[luke 8 26|Luk.8:26]]; ἐν χ. καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου, [[matthew 4 16|Mat.4:16;]] (b) land, property: [[luke 12 16|Luk.12:16;]] (with) the country, opposite to the town; so in pl., [[luke 21 21|Luk.21:21]], [[john 4 35|Jhn.4:35]], [[james 5 4|Jas.5:4]].† SYN.: ἄγρος, τόπος (cf. DCG, i, 591a; LS, see word χώρα, ad init.). (AS)

χωρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[genesis 13 6|Gen.13:6]] (נָשָׂא), 3Ki.7:26 7:38 (כּוּל hi.), [[2-chronicles 4 5|2Ch.4:5]] (חָזַק hi.), Wis.7:23-24, al. ;] I. Intrans., 1. to make room, give way, retire, pass: before εἰς, [[matthew 15 17|Mat.15:17;]] metaphorically (EV, come), εἰς μετάνοιαν, [[2-peter 3 9|2Pe.3:9.]] 2. to go forward, advance, progress (Plat., Polyb., al.) ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ. ἐν ὑμῖν, [[john 8 37|Jhn.8:37]] (R, txt., hath not free course; R, mg., hath no place, for WH. cf. Field, Notes, 94 f.). II. Trans., to have space for holding, to hold: [[mark 2 2|Mrk.2:2]] (cf. Ge, l.with), [[john 21 25|Jhn.21:25;]] of measures (1Ki, 2Ch, ll. with), [[john 2 6|Jhn.2:6.]] Metaphorical, of having or making room in mind or heart: [[matthew 19 11|Mat.19:11-12]] (EV, receive), [[2-corinthians 7 2|2Co.7:2]] (R, txt., open your hearts; mg., make room) (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ὑπο-χωρέω).† (AS)

χωρίζω [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 12 8|2Ch.12:8]], al. (בָּדַל ni., etc.), Wis.1:3, 2Ma.5:21, al. ;] 1. to separate, divide, put asunder: with accusative of thing(s), opposite to συζεύγνυμι [[matthew 19 6|Mat.19:6]], [[mark 10 9|Mrk.10:9]]; with accusative of person(s), before ἀπό (Wis.1:3), [[romans 8 35|Rom.8:35, 39]]; pf. pass ptcp., [[hebrews 7 26|Heb.7:26.]] 2. In late writers, mid. and 1 aor pass., to separate oneself, depart: Phm 15; before ἀπό [[acts 1 4|Act.1:4]], ἐκ, [[acts 18 1|Act.18:1-2;]] of divorce (polyb., al.), [[1-corinthians 7 10|1Co.7:10-11 7:15]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-χωρίζω).† (AS)

χωρίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 27 27|1Ch.27:27]] (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;] 1. a place, region. 2. an estate, property, piece of land: [[matthew 26 36|Mat.26:36]], [[mark 14 32|Mrk.14:32]], [[john 4 5|Jhn.4:5]], [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7]].† (AS)

χωρίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 27 27|1Ch.27:27]] (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;] 1. a place, region. 2. an estate, property, piece of land: [[matthew 26 36|Mat.26:36]], [[mark 14 32|Mrk.14:32]], [[john 4 5|Jhn.4:5]], [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7]].† (AS)

χωρίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 27 27|1Ch.27:27]] (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;] 1. a place, region. 2. an estate, property, piece of land: [[matthew 26 36|Mat.26:36]], [[mark 14 32|Mrk.14:32]], [[john 4 5|Jhn.4:5]], [[acts 1 18|Act.1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7]].† (AS)

χωρίς adv., 1. separately, apart: [[john 20 7|Jhn.20:7.]] 2. the North-west wind , Lat. Caurus, (New Testament) (ML)

ψάλλω [in LXX chiefly for זָמַר pi. ([[judges 5 3|Jdg.5:3]], [[psalms 7 17|Psa.7:17]], al.), also for נָגַן pi. ([[1-samuel 16 16|1Ki.16:16]] ff, al.) ;] 1. to pull, twitch, twang (as a bowstring, etc.; Æsch., Eur., al.), hence, 2. absol., (a) to play a stringed instrument with the fingers (Hdt., Plat., al.); (b) later, to sing to a harp, sing psalms (LXX); in NT, to sing a hymn, sing praise: [[james 5 13|Jas.5:13;]] with dative of person(s), [[romans 15 9|Rom.15:9]] (LXX), [[ephesians 5 19|Eph.5:19;]] dative instr., [[1-corinthians 14 15|1Co.14:15.]]† (AS)

ψαλμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ψάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְמוֹר ;] 1. a striking, twitching with the fingers (Eur., al.), hence, a striking of musical strings (Æsch., a1.), and hence in later writers, 2. a sacred song sung to musical accompaniment, a psalm (LXX): [[1-corinthians 14 26|1Co.14:26]], [[ephesians 5 19|Eph.5:19]], [[colossians 3 16|Col.3:16]]; of OT psalms, [[luke 24 44|Luk.24:44]], [[acts 13 33|Act.13:33]]; βίβλος ψαλμῶν, [[luke 20 42|Luk.20:42]], [[acts 1 20|Act.1:20]].† SYN.: see: ὕμνος (AS)
ψευδ-άδελφος, -ου, ὁ a false brother: of professing Christians, [[2-corinthians 11 26|2Co.11:26]], [[galatians 2 4|Gal.2:4]].† (AS)
ψευδ-απόστολος, -ου, ὁ a false apostle: [[2-corinthians 11 13|2Co.11:13.]]† (AS)

ψευδής, -ές (ψεύδομαι), [in LXX for שֶׁקֶר, שָׁוְא, כָּזָב; etc. ;] lying, false, untrue (of persons and things): [[revelation 2 2|Rev.2:2;]] μάρτυρες, [[acts 6 13|Act.6:13;]] as subst., ὁ ψ., a liar: [[revelation 21 8|Rev.21:8.]]† (AS)
ψευδο-διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ a false teacher: [[2-peter 2 1|2Pe.2:1.]]† (AS)
ψευδο-λόγος, -ον (ψευδής, λέγω), speaking falsely, lying: [[1-timothy 4 2|1Ti.4:2]] (Aristoph., Polyb., al.).† (AS)

Like act., with accusative, to deceive by lies (Æsch., al.): [[acts 5 3|Act.5:3.]]† (AS)
ψευδο-μάρτυς, -υρος, ὁ [in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:60-61 Bl * ;] a false witness: [[matthew 26 60|Mat.26:60;]] with genitive obj. (see WM, § 30, 1a), [[1-corinthians 15 15|1Co.15:15.]]† (AS)

ψευδο-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[exodus 20 16|Exo.20:16]], [[deuteronomy 5 20|Deu.5:20]] (17) (עָנָה), Da TH Su 1:61 AB2R (see ψευδομάρτυς) * ;] to bear false witness: [[matthew 19 18|Mat.19:18]], [[mark 10 19|Mrk.10:19]], [[luke 18 20|Luk.18:20]]" (LXX) ; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[mark 14 56|Mrk.14:56-57]] (Xen., Plat., al.).† (AS)
ψευδο-μαρτυρία, -ας, ἡ false witness: [[matthew 15 19|Mat.15:19 26:59]].† (AS)

ψευδο-προφήτης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[zechariah 13 2|Zec.13:2]], [[jeremiah 1 9|Jer.1:9]] ([[jeremiah 6 13|Jer.6:13]], al.) (נָבִיא)* ;] a false prophet (= cl. ψευδόμαντις): [[matthew 7 15|Mat.7:15 24:11, 24]], [[mark 13 22|Mrk.13:22]] (see Swete, in l), [[luke 6 26|Luk.6:26]], [[acts 13 6|Act.13:6]], [[2-peter 2 1|2Pe.2:1]], [[1-john 4 1|1Jn.4:1]], [[revelation 16 13|Rev.16:13 19:20 20:10]] † (AS)

ψεῦδος, -εος (-ους), τό [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶר, also for כַּחַשׁ, כָּזָב ;] a falsehood, untruth, lie: [[revelation 14 15|Rev.14:15;]] opposite to ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[john 8 44|Jhn.8:44]], [[romans 1 25|Rom.1:25]], [[ephesians 4 25|Eph.4:25]], [[2-thessalonians 2 11|2Th.2:11]], [[1-john 2 21|1Jn.2:21]]; to τὸ ἀληθές, [[1-john 2 27|1Jn.2:27;]] ποιεῖν ψ., [[revelation 21 27|Rev.21:27 22:15]]; ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει κ. σημείοις κ. τέρασιν ψεύδους (genitive qual., see M, Th., 104; and on the meaning and construction, see also ICC, in l), [[2-thessalonians 2 9|2Th.2:9.]]† (AS)

ψευδώνυμος, -ον (ψευδής, ὄνομα) under a false name, falsely called: [[1-timothy 6 20|1Ti.6:20]] (Æsch., Plut., a1.).† (AS)
ψεῦσμα, -τος, τό (ψεύδω), [in Aq., Th.: [[job 34 6|Job.34:6]], [[proverbs 23 3|Pro.23:3]]; in Sm.: [[job 13 4|Job.13:4]], al. ;] a lie, falsehood: [[romans 3 7|Rom.3:7]] (Plat., Plut. al.).† (AS)

ψηλαφάω, -ῶ (ψάω, to touch), [in LXX for מוּשׁ, מָשַׁשׁ pi., etc. ;] 1. to feel or grope about; with accusative, to feel about for, search after: metaphorically, of seeking God, [[acts 17 27|Act.17:27.]] 2. to feel, touch, handle: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 24 39|Luk.24:39]], [[1-john 1 1|1Jn.1:1]]; προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ (ὄρει ?), [[hebrews 12 18|Heb.12:18]] (R, txt., a mount that might be touched; mg., a palpable and kindled fire; see Westc., in l).† (AS)

ψηφίζω (ψῆφος), [in LXX: 3Ki.3:8 8:5 A (סָפַר ni..) * ;] to count (prop., with pebbles), reckon, calculate: τ. δαπάνην, [[luke 14 28|Luk.14:28;]] τ. ἀριθμόν (i.e. calculate the number's meaning), [[revelation 13 18|Rev.13:18]] (in cl. chiefly mid., to vote by casting a pebble; cf. συγ-κατα-, συμ-φηφίζω).† (AS)

ψῆφος, -ου, ἡ (ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: [[exodus 4 25|Exo.4:25]] (צֹר), [[lamentations 3 16|La 3:16]] (חָצָץ), [[ecclesiastes 7 26|Ecc.7:26]] (25) (צֹר), [[2-kings 12 4|4Ki.12:4]] (5) A, Sir.18:10, 4Ma.15:26 * ;] 1. a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), [[revelation 2 17|Rev.2:17.]] 2. ψῆφος, -ου, ἡ (ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: [[exodus 4 25|Exo.4:25]] (צֹר), [[lamentations 3 16|La 3:16]] (חָצָץ), [[ecclesiastes 7 26|Ecc.7:26]] (25) (צֹר), [[2-kings 12 4|4Ki.12:4]] (5) A, Sir.18:10, 4Ma.15:26 * ;] 1. a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), [[revelation 2 17|Rev.2:17.]] 2. From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote: [[acts 26 10|Act.26:10.]]† (AS)

ψιθυρισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ψιθυρίζω, to whisper), [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 10 11|Ecc.10:11]] (לַחַשׁ) * ;] a whispering; (a) of secret slander, [[2-corinthians 12 20|2Co.12:20]] (Plut.); (b) of a murmured enchantment, Ec, l.with† (AS)
ψιθυριστής, -οῦ, ὁ (see supr.), a whisperer (as epithet of Hermes, Dem., 1358, 6): in bad sense, [[romans 1 30|Rom.1:30.]]† Syn.: καταλάλος, q.v (AS)
ψιχίον, -ου, τό dimin. of ψίξ, a crumb: [[matthew 15 27|Mat.15:27]], [[mark 7 28|Mrk.7:28]].† (AS)
